rule: Every incorrect genuine MAYHEM tip triggers a forensic failure audit before its lessons may affect future decisions. The audit must distinguish pre-match analytical defects from post-kickoff events and must not rewrite the frozen decision.

audits.core_finding: The 68% Cowboys confidence was not supported by the available evidence. MAYHEM stacked correlated consensus signals, failed to anchor on structural parity, and treated Canberra's debut-half uncertainty predominantly as downside instead of variance.

pre_match_evidence.market: Published head-to-head snapshots clustered around Cowboys $1.48-$1.55 and Raiders $2.45-$2.50. Removing bookmaker overround implies a Cowboys probability of roughly 61.7%-62.3%, materially below MAYHEM's 68%.
pre_match_evidence.structural_baseline: Official Round 27 ladder state showed Cowboys 13-10 with -64 point differential and Raiders 10-13 with -65 point differential: effectively identical season scoring differential despite the ladder gap.
raiders_context: Canberra entered off a Round 26 bye
Coby Black debuted at halfback after strong NSW Cup form
Raiders retained substantial senior forward experience including Papalii and Joe Tapine

failure_mechanisms.finding: MAYHEM set 68%, around six percentage points above the normalized market baseline, without independent evidence strong enough to justify the uplift.

Market price plus two model outputs were treated as multiple corroborating signals even though they may share common priors, market information or team-strength inputs. Consensus was mistaken for independence.
The Cowboys' finals position and home record were allowed to dominate a critical counter-signal: Cowboys and Raiders had almost identical season point differentials (-64 versus -65).
Nanai, Neame and Laybutt were all unavailable. The existing checkpoint acknowledged the attrition but did not reduce confidence enough relative to the structural baseline.
Coby Black's debut was used mainly as a Canberra weakness. The correct pre-match treatment was high uncertainty/variance because strong lower-grade performance created both downside and upside tails.
The decision record did not force a full Raiders-win case before freezing Cowboys. A MAYHEM decision must attempt to defeat its own preferred hypothesis before confidence is accepted.

verified: Coby Black scored 26 points on debut from two tries and nine goals.
Reuben Cotter was sin-binned in the opening passage after high contact on Josh Papalii.
post_match_validation.interpretation: The Cotter sin-bin was a post-kickoff event and cannot be used to claim the pre-match Raiders case was obvious. It is therefore excluded as a pre-match analytical defect. The larger failure remains that 68% confidence was unjustified before the game began.

mandatory_corrections: NORMALISE_MARKET: convert head-to-head prices to overround-adjusted implied probabilities before using market probability as a reference.
INDEPENDENCE_GRAPH: evidence from market-linked or shared-input models counts as one evidence family unless independence is established.
CONFIDENCE_JUSTIFICATION_GATE: any MAYHEM confidence more than 3 percentage points above the normalized market requires explicit independent evidence and a written causal mechanism.
STRUCTURAL_BASELINE_GATE: compare season point differential, recent scoring differential and venue split before narrative factors such as ladder position or finals status can increase confidence.
ROSTER_BURDEN_GATE: quantify directional roster losses by unit and replacement quality before home advantage is applied.
DEBUTANT_VARIANCE_RULE: debut/low-sample players expand uncertainty unless evidence supports a directional downgrade; novelty alone is not negative evidence.
ADVERSARIAL_INVERSION: before every freeze, construct the strongest evidence-supported case for the opposing selection and record what would falsify the preferred tip.
INCORRECT_TIP_HALT: after an incorrect genuine tip, the failure audit must be completed before learned weights are carried into later fixtures.
audits.integrity: No retrospective tip switch. Cowboys 68% remains frozen and incorrect. The audit changes future process, not the historical record.
